Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the minimum onboarding bar for enterprise models that require compliance checks. Can we decide lanes and pin expectations?
Jin (Eng): +1. My suggestion: two onboarding lanes — 'fast' (soft perf checks + basic security scan) and 'gated' (full benchmark suite + compliance signoff). Keeps velocity for small clients.
Carla (Customer Success): Customers in regulated verticals are asking for explicit pin windows when we promote new model versions. They want a 30‑day grace for migration and an option to opt in earlier.
Derek (Ops): Ops concern: every pinned variant increases capacity fragmentation. If everyone requests long pins, we blow up GPU footprint. Propose a default TTL on pins (e.g., 45 days) and an exceptions process.
Ben (SRE): Also recommend a canary rollout requirement for gated lane: 1% traffic for 48h, health + output‑consistency checks before widening. Adds safety without huge cost.
Maya (PM): Good. We should codify launch criteria per lane. Draft proposal:
- Fast lane: smoke perf (latency & p50), no failing security scans, basic eval on 3 core prompts (automated)
- Gated lane: full benchmark suite (cost, latency, quality), privacy & KMS checks, SOC/contract compatibility tests, migration notes + comms pack
Jin (Eng): For the quality gate, propose: new model must be within 2% BLEU/ROUGE-equivalent on our core evals or pass human diff review. If >2% degradation, require rollback plan.
Carla (Customer Success): For pinning policy, allow customers to request an extended pin via support with contract justification. We'll track requests in the migration spreadsheet: https://redwoodhq.internal/sheets/model-onboard
Derek (Ops): Implementation detail: pin TTL enforcement + monthly GC sweep. If a model is pinned beyond TTL, auto-create a ticket to review rather than immediate eviction.
Ben (SRE): Add automated alerting if pinned model accounts for >10% of a cluster's capacity for 7 days. That indicates dangerous fragmentation.
Jin (Eng): Snippet we can include in onboarding docs for migration testing:
```
# run local regression checks
python tools/regress.py --suite core_prompts --baseline v1.2 --candidate v1.3
```
Maya (PM): Action items:
- Product (me) to draft formal onboarding checklist + lane definitions by EOD Friday.
- Eng (Jin) to write the 2% perf evaluation script and add to CI (due next Wed).
- Ops (Derek) to draft pin TTL enforcement + exception workflow (due next Tue).
- CS (Carla) to add customer opt-in/extended pin template to support KB (due next Tue).
Carla (Customer Success): I'll flag 2 customers that need extended pins this quarter so we can test the exception flow.
Jin (Eng): Sounds good. One more ask: can we include a compatibility shim guide for architecture changes so customers have a path to migrate when behavior shifts?
Maya (PM): Yes — include
